claims: NASA's Artemis II mission successfully launched on Wednesday, April 1, 2026, at 6:35 p.m. EDT from Launch Complex 39B at Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
The SLS rocket is taking four astronauts on a 10-day crewed mission around the Moon.
Liftoff for NASA's Artemis II mission occurred 11 minutes after the scheduled 6:24 p.m. window opening.
NASA's Artemis II mission is the first crewed lunar flyby in over 50 years.
The astronauts on NASA's Artemis II mission are Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
Live coverage of NASA's Artemis II launch is on NASA+.
Live coverage of NASA's Artemis II launch is on YouTube.
Live coverage of NASA's Artemis II launch is on social platforms.
